description: ADMIN ONLY. Generate + export 3D slash/thrust/spin VFX on an existing Library bind, or a world-space fire meteor (head + trail + impact). Pass prompt to fill type/style/color/emitters. Returns studio_url to edit the saved effect in GripForge, workspace_id, GLB, PNG, vfx.json + snippets. Refused for non-admin keys.

attach_id.description: Library bind id (lib_…). Not required for meteor.

core.description: portal only: shadow-core radius as a fraction of the portal (default 0.09)

look.description: toon: stylized ribbon/lightning; solid: filled beam; crystal: faceted weapon trail; flame: burning crescent; pulse: released electric orb; firejet: flared fire stream with torn tongues and pressure rings; impact: slam-family comic explosion with red telegraph, violet core, ink debris and optional impact frames

prompt.description: Natural-language VFX prompt. Fills type/style/color/emitters when omitted.

type.description: Strike type (default slash). portal = standing blood rift / demonic seal (world-space, loops); slam = ground-impact eruption: light pillar + fireball + sparks/debris (world-space, one-shot)

name: gripforge_vfx
